audit.why: 47.69% Emerald+ and 8/10 HARD hold up: Riven's kill window opens at level 2 with Broken Wings plus Ki Burst and stays open until Kassadin has Riftwalk and Rod of Ages. She is resourceless, so she can re-throw the all-in as fast as her cooldowns allow while Kassadin pays 60-80 mana per Null Sphere.

audit.whatIsWrong: win[5] and win[6] said Riven while their captions said the opposite — whys[5] 'you climb to roughly even' is Skill, and whys[6] 'assassinate her once her E and Q3 are down and she falls off' is a Kassadin win. full.phases[5]/[6] carried the same mismatch under a why that reads 'The monster is awake... Hunt.'
audit.why: Riven is a snowball bruiser with no scaling answer to stacked Riftwalk; the pages already say so in prose on both layers. Only the side labels disagreed.
audit.corrected: First item to Skill, Two+ items to Kassadin on win[] and phases[].side. Level 6 stays Skill and the early four stay Riven — no invented shift.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) The content layer repeatedly told you to 'blink out of her Q3 knockup and Ki Burst stun'. You cannot cast Riftwalk while stunned or knocked up — the blink has to be spent on her dash-in, before the CC lands, and the page never said so. (b) The full layer still carries the champion-wide template errors: tradeGood, dosFull[1] and breakdown.trading say to walk out 'as the shield absorbs his counter', dosFull[0].t says 'absorb with Q shield', breakdown.cooldowns says 'Q shield is the lifeline', and report[6] says 'Fleet plus Q shield is how you survive' — but Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage only and Riven is entirely physical. The content layer already gets this right, so the two layers contradicted each other. Also missing: Valor (E) is a dash that blocks incoming damage of any type, so bursting into it wastes your whole combo.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere: 'a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Riot's Valor: 'Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.' Riven's kit lists no magic damage and no resource cost on any ability.
audit.corrected: Blink timing is now stated as 'on her dash-in, before the stun lands, because once it lands Riftwalk is unusable'; the full-layer shield claims are replaced with 'she is pure physical, so the Q shield absorbs none of her counter'; Valor's all-damage shield is now named in Key Ability Interactions and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet found no wrong ability names here, but there was not a single cooldown number on the page — every line said 'bait Ki Burst' or 'wait for her E' with nothing to count.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Broken Wings 13s flat. Riven pays no resource, so cooldowns are the only limit on how often she can commit — which makes the numbers the whole lane.
audit.corrected: The 11s Ki Burst, 10s Valor and 13s Broken Wings are now in mid, whys[3], winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and dosFull[2], with the resourceless point stated once so the numbers mean something.

audit.why: Null Sphere does not silence — Riot's text is 'dealing damage and interrupting channels'.

notes: The content layer for this matchup was already correct that Null Sphere's shield is magic-only; the full layer said the opposite in five places. Worth knowing that the wrong version is templated across every Kassadin matchup, so the same five fields are wrong on the pages I have not reached. Also the standing kit-flag misfire: kassadin.json marks Null Sphere as a channel and _missing-interactions.json builds 'Riven can cancel your Null Sphere (Q) with Ki Burst (W)' on it — Riot's description says Null Sphere interrupts channels rather than being one, so I did not write that row.
